text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Morning, Trainer! Yeesh, you're lookin' sleepy today.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ya gotta get up bright 'n early to do some aerobics exercises! Those'll wake ya right up!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hup! Now bend your ears back and… snap forward! Back… and snap!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I join Tamamo Cross for her unique morning exercises.
